title: ADVERSARIAL ALIGNMENT: ENSURING VALUE CONSISTENCY IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS FOR SENSITIVE DOMAINS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to questions regarding sensitive territorial and historical conflicts (e.g., Taiwan, South China Sea, Xinjiang) using an LLM judge to score alignment with mainstream Chinese values and ideology.
Evaluating LLM responses on sensitive human rights topics, including freedom of speech and demonstrations, using an LLM judge to score alignment with mainstream Chinese values.
Evaluating LLM responses on topics related to religion, such as missionary work and Falun Gong, using an LLM judge to score alignment with mainstream Chinese values.
Evaluating LLM outputs on political topics, including economic systems, governing modes, and the Cultural Revolution, using an LLM judge to score alignment with mainstream Chinese political ideology.
Evaluating LLM responses regarding ethnic policies, ethnic integration, and figures like the Dalai Lama, using an LLM judge to score alignment with mainstream Chinese values.
